publication: No modern locator thumbnails or article reproductions were downloaded or included. Evidence uses official Yale images and previously downloaded official IIIF source regions. Full local paths are provenance only; websites may project relative paths without changing these archived bytes.
limitations: Known proposed targets introduce expectation bias. No alternative-target or forced-choice experiment was done.
Visible shape similarity does not establish species, historical identity, text attachment, sound value or translation.
The source31 text-to-object attachment remains ambiguous.
f40v and f43v have two separate target drawings; neither pair is assigned a unique target object.
Folds, paint loss, scale differences and backside show-through limit geometric comparison.

Downloaded full-resolution file hashes do not imply every native pixel was visually inspected; all twelve whole canvases were viewed through official 1200-wide overviews, with native region checks for two target panels and one source object.
